subject: Request: brief pilot hold while purchase clears — temporary escrow offer
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@vanguardhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vanguardhealth.com
Date: 2027-09-14T15:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Dylan,

Quick update from our side — procurement has flagged the invoice routing because our vendor onboarding team needs the final SOC2 attestation and a signed vendor agreement. Legal is taking a closer look and it looks like the approval will slip at least a week.

The product team is happy with the results so far; we really don’t want the sandbox to time out. Is there any way Redwood can hold the pilot open for a short window or provide a temporary token credit while the PO is routed?

Thanks,
Ayesha
Procurement liaison (working with product)
Vanguard Health
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the hassle.

We can help keep the pilot live while your PO clears. Two practical options we can offer right now:

1) Temporary pilot credit: we can grant a 7-day token allowance (equivalent to ~$1,500 of usage) tied to your account to preserve the evaluation environment.
2) Escrow-style hold: we can suspend the trial timer and keep the workspace active for up to 10 days provided we receive a signed acknowledgement (short form) from procurement confirming the PO is in-flight.

If either is OK, I’ll loop in Olga to apply the credit and Jasmine to share the short acknowledgement template and the limited terms. We can also attach a SOC2 stub and our compliance checklist if that helps speed legal.

Which do you prefer? If you’d like both, we can do credit + timer suspension as a one-time goodwill gesture.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@vanguardhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vanguardhealth.com, Tom Bradford <t.bradford@vanguardhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and next steps

Dylan — thank you, that would be ideal. We’d like the 7-day credit while legal signs off. Procurement will provide a short email acknowledgement verifying PO routing; legal still wants to see SOC2 in hand for the full contract, but a stub is fine for now.

I’ve attached the procurement checklist they sent (summarized). I copied Tom from vendor onboarding so he has visibility. Once you share the acknowledgement template we’ll get procurement to sign it.

Appreciate the help — this keeps momentum with engineering.

—Ayesha

Attachment: procurement-checklist-summary.txt (see procurement@vanguardhealth.com)
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@vanguardhealth.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-15T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and next steps

Hi Ayesha — looping in 2 resources to quickly action this.

Dylan, per Ayesha’s ask: I’ll provision a 7-day $1,500 credit to Vanguard Health (account id VN-4932) and flag the sandbox so it won’t expire during that window. Jasmine — can you drop the acknowledgement template and the short pilot terms?

Ayesha — we will also attach a SOC2 summary and a short terms PDF to this thread (no full report) so legal has something to review while the detailed report follows under NDA if needed.

Attachment: temporary-pilot-terms-0927.pdf (pilot credit + timer suspension terms)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@vanguardhealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-16T08:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and next steps

Ayesha — thanks. Please reply to this message from procurement with one of the two short ack options below so we can finalize:

Option A (credit only): 
"Vanguard Health confirms Redwood may apply a 7-day complimentary credit to account VN-4932 while procurement routes a PO. Vanguard understands final billing will occur once the PO is processed."

Option B (credit + timer suspension): 
"Vanguard Health confirms Redwood may apply a 7-day complimentary credit and suspend the trial timer for up to 10 days while procurement routes a PO. Vanguard understands final billing will occur after PO processing and accepts these limited pilot terms."

I’ve also attached the short terms and a SOC2 report stub we can share immediately.

Attachments: soc2-report-stub.txt, temporary-pilot-terms-0927.pdf

—Jasmine (Customer Success)

"Vanguard Health confirms Redwood may apply a 7-day complimentary credit and suspend the trial timer for up to 10 days while procurement routes a PO. Vanguard understands final billing will occur after PO processing and accepts these limited pilot terms."

Ayesha
